description.zh: 正计时，带计次 —— 卡片关着也接着走
description.en: Counts up, with laps — keeps running while the card is closed

items.zh: 右边那个按钮管开始、暂停和继续，按钮上的字跟着状态变，和专注计时器一样。
items.en: The right button starts, pauses and resumes — it reads Start, Pause, then Resume, the same way the Focus timer does.

items.zh: 左边那个按钮跟着状态变：跑着的时候是计次，停着的时候是重置，所以不会有一颗按了没反应的按钮。
items.en: The left button changes with the state: it is Lap while running and Reset while stopped, so there is never a button that would do nothing.

items.zh: 每按一次计次就记一圈，存的是按下去的那一刻。最新的一圈在最上面，带这一圈的用时和到那时的总时长。
items.en: Each lap records the moment you pressed it. The newest lap is at the top, with the split for that lap and the total so far.

items.zh: 圈会跟着暂停和继续留下来。重置把它们和时间一起清掉。
items.en: Laps survive a pause and a resume. Reset clears them along with the time.

title.en: It keeps counting while the card is closed

items.zh: 存的只是按下开始的那一刻，不是已经过去的时间。重新打开卡片时按这个起点重算，所以跑了一整晚的秒表读出来就是一整晚。
items.en: Only the moment you pressed Start is stored, never the elapsed time. Reopening the card works the number out again, so a stopwatch left running overnight reads the whole night.

items.zh: 也就是说机器睡眠也算时间 —— 它数的是墙上时钟走过多久，不是你坐在屏幕前多久。
items.en: That also means sleeping the machine counts as time — it is a wall-clock span, not time spent in front of the screen.

items.zh: 两个秒表不共用一个钟：每一份各计各的。
items.en: Two Stopwatch widgets do not share one clock: each instance keeps its own time.

changes.zh: 界面和说明都支持中文了：按钮、圈列表和说明都跟着平台的语言走。
changes.en: Interface and help are bilingual now: the buttons, the lap list and the help follow the platform language.

changes.zh: 读数不再跑到右上角的窗口按钮下面了。
changes.en: The reading no longer runs under the window buttons in the top-right corner.

changes.zh: 第一个版本：开始、暂停、继续、重置和计次。
changes.en: First release: start, pause, resume, reset and laps.

changes.zh: 卡片关着也接着走 —— 它存的是按下去的那一刻，不是已经过去的时间。
changes.en: Keeps running while the card is closed, because it stores the start moment rather than the time so far.
